# The pub's neon sign: a crescent moon and a star, 4.5 cm tubes standing 3 cm off the wall (unlit
# in the scene). Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y, origin at the moon's centre on the wall.
new
material new Tube --base-color 1.0000 0.3765 1.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name T0 --size 1 --location 0.0550 -0.05 0.2053
scale 0.1499 0.0450 0.0450
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -165.000 0
apply --rotation
